correctness.rationale: Proof independently reconstructed: diagonal nth-root eigenvalues are shifted logarithmic Cesàro averages; all fixed-offset exponents differ by at most 2B(k-1)/n; WOT first diagonal entries recover every log-coordinate limit and boundedness upgrades to SOT. Consecutive vector Cesàro jumps tend to zero, yielding a connected compact cluster. For arbitrary compact connected K, shrinking-chain polygonal tours yield a bounded 1-Lipschitz curve with omega-limit K, including non-path-connected K. Sampling at log n preserves omega-limit; the inverse Cesàro difference b_n=n c_n-(n-1)c_(n-1) is uniformly bounded by R+1 and telescopes exactly. Compact connected C times a simplex gives the complete interval formula for W_a. The independent Python checker run from the actual standalone file passed 8266 finite assertions; those are diagnostic and do not substitute for the analytical proof.

value.rationale: Provides a natural complete classification of all possible WOT root-cluster shapes for a finite direct sum of uniformly bounded-below unilateral shifts. It demonstrates a sharp jump from scalar intervals in one summand to every positive planar continuum in two, including nonconvex and non-locally-connected sets, while the associated asymptotic numerical range collapses this geometry to one exact interval. Both directions and all finite d are included; not a one-off example or a table recomputation.
